data.title: 猫猫 · 药房的调配
data.description: 药房抽屉柜与工作台之间，猫猫核对封好的草药包与小秤，鼻尖沾着一点植物粉末。绿衣袖口束起，蓝瞳专注，木抽屉和整齐器具映着窗光；画面不展示可读配方或剂量。
data.action: 药房抽屉柜与工作台之间，猫猫核对封好的草药包与小秤，鼻尖沾着一点植物粉末
data.promptProse: Maomao compares sealed herb packets with a small balance between the pharmacy drawers and workbench, plant powder dusting her nose. Her green sleeves are tied back over the cream inner collar, blue eyes intent. The medium portrait includes orderly tools and wooden drawer fronts, without readable recipes or doses. Window light falls on the packets and scale pan, glinting along its edge and leaving clear but soft drawer-handle shadows behind her.
